## Overview

Internal source-mirror maintenance.
## Interface

- `internal_sources.rb:print_usage/validate_checksum!/exists_in_artifactory?/maybe_upload` implement `<yaml-path> [only]` CLI; internal_sources.yml lists software sources.
## Invariants

- `internal_sources.rb:validate_checksum!` compares response headers in sha256, md5, sha1 priority; unknown checksum type raises. It does not locally hash downloaded bytes.
- `internal_sources.rb` requires one or two arguments and an existing YAML path; optional only filters software by name.
## Side Effects

- `internal_sources.rb:maybe_upload` issues HTTPS HEAD requests, invokes wget and curl, writes temporary files and uploads to ARTIFACTORY_REPO_URL using ARTIFACTORY_PASSWORD. Do not use the upload CLI as a read-only validation command.
## Verification

From the `omnibus-software` repository root after installing the Gemfile dependencies: `bundle exec rake test` loads all software definitions; `bundle exec rake style` checks Ruby style. Full platform builds are separate and execute the build side effects above.
